name: Can I customize my pre-construction unit?

mainEntity.name: Can I customize my pre-construction unit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, many pre-construction developments offer customization options, especially for early buyers. These typically include choices for flooring, cabinetry, countertops, and fixtures, and sometimes even minor layout modifications. The extent of customization depends on the developer's policy and the construction stage. Be aware that extensive customizations might incur additional costs and could potentially impact the unit's completion timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most pre-construction units allow customization of finishes, and sometimes minor layouts, depending on the developer and construction stage.
